confirmed: The fixed rational family, positive eta, degree constant and time constant are chosen before the half-dimension m. The same native machine handles every positive m and every bank of the canonical row width.

The native output uses precisely the simple deduplicated overlap incidence whose row/column degree and uniform core expansion are proved. No separate graph or assumed matching schedule is substituted.
Graph address reversal is only an equivalence in the expansion proof. The target flag reversal used by the machine is paid by leftward mask writing and is applied exactly once before expansion.
The complete theorem starts at Transpose.init with blank work tapes, uses the original raw read-only input, proves native stepN termination, and identifies the append-only raw output through outRev.
rawBank_surjective supplies every input string of the required length; the bank-typed endpoint does not silently restrict input contents.

Dimension discovery, retained d and d/2, actual rational opcode generation, two counter copies, opcode rewind, unary W clock, both mask/tag banks, payload copy, all page/reset calls and final output are included. Both outer linking jumps and all preparatory jumps are charged.

Absolute head positions and untouched metadata frames are carried through each phase. The true-side mask shift does not become a free row or tag permutation. Final tag origins match the data executor.
The aggregate numerical lemma absorbs the actual component budgets into a fixed constant times P. It does not assume the desired machine running-time bound.
The English statement matches even canonical dimensions d=2m>=2. It makes no unsupported claim for odd dimensions or arbitrary row widths.

Involution, zero forward column radius, bounded inverse support/reuse, and interval-recovery consequences use the same shear map. The prose excludes a transpose decoder, exchange saving and arbitrary globally mixing recodings.
